name: langchain-salesforce
headline: AI-Powered Web Scraping with oxylabs-ai-studio-py
short_description: Harness the power of AI for structured data gathering from any website with oxylabs-ai-studio-py. This Python SDK enables intelligent web scraping and crawling using natural language prompts, ensuring your LLM agents are equipped with the freshest data.
author: oxylabs

sections.overview:
oxylabs-ai-studio-py is a Python SDK that integrates AI capabilities for intelligent web scraping and data extraction. It allows developers to use natural language prompts to define scraping tasks, making it easier to gather structured data from websites without writing complex parsing logic. The SDK is designed specifically for LLM agents and AI applications that need fresh, real-time data from web sources. By combining natural language processing with web crawling, it simplifies the process of building data pipelines for machine learning models and AI agents. This tool is particularly useful for developers building Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI agent applications that require reliable web data access.
Collect market research data from various websites to analyze trends and consumer behavior.
Perform competitor analysis by scraping product details and pricing from competitor sites.
Generate leads by extracting contact information from business directories and social media platforms.
Aggregate content from multiple sources for comprehensive insights and reporting.
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
